_meta.usage: nine-digit national landline number (e.g. 71 123 45 67, 66 234 56 78) or in international format (+998 71 123 45 67). Type the whole number: a bare code on its own does not match
_meta.note: Nine-digit closed national numbering plan; 71 Tashkent city and suburban districts, 70 Tashkent Region, 78 Tashkent commercial/alternative fixed networks, 66 Samarkand, 73 Fergana, 74 Andijan, 69 Namangan, 65 Bukhara, 61 Karakalpakstan (Nukus), 62 Khorezm (Urgench), 75 Kashkadarya, 76 Surkhandarya, 72 Jizzakh, 67 Syrdarya, 79 Navoiy.
_meta.miss_note: not an Uzbek geographic landline: mobile numbers (90/91 Beeline, 93/94/55 Ucell, 97/88 Mobiuz, 99/95/77 Uzmobile, 33 Humans, 98 Perfectum), short numbers, freephone (800) or a number of another country
